BiblicalUsage: Wherefore lay apart all filthiness and superfluity of naughtiness, and receive with meekness the engrafted word, which is able to save your souls.
TheologicalSignificance: I take it that filthiness is laid apart before the word can be received, and meekness is the hand that lays it down.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
